nodes.description: mapping(address => uint256) private _balances; holds every holder balance and is mutated by _transfer/_mint/_burn
mapping(address => mapping(address => uint256)) private _allowances; ERC20 allowance table read in transferFrom and written in _approve
uint256 private _totalSupply; increased by _mint and decreased by _burn
uint256 private FeeNumber; pseudo-random fee divisor written on every _transfer from block.difficulty and block.timestamp
uint256 private feeAmount; per-transfer fee, 1 wei for DevWallet counterparties otherwise amount*FeeNumber/100
address private DevWallet = 0x7f1F88A2d2429377F791b2b21e5d5f0EbbB4b46D; fee-exempt privileged address hardcoded at deploy time
transfer(address recipient, uint256 amount) public; erc20 entry point delegating to _transfer(_msgSender(), recipient, amount)
transferFrom(address sender, address recipient, uint256 amount) public; delegates to _transfer then decrements allowance via _approve
_transfer(address sender, address recipient, uint256 amount) internal; core vulnerable routine: computes timestamp/difficulty fee, calls _burn and rewrites _balances
_burn(address account, uint256 amount) internal; reduces _balances[account] and _totalSupply, used to destroy the transfer fee
_mint(address account, uint256 amount) internal; increases _totalSupply and _balances[account]
_approve(address owner, address spender, uint256 amount) internal; writes the _allowances table
approve(address spender, uint256 amount) public; calls _approve(_msgSender(), spender, amount)
increaseAllowance(address spender, uint256 addedValue) public; adds to the caller allowance
decreaseAllowance(address spender, uint256 subtractedValue) public; checks and subtracts from the caller allowance
balanceOf(address account) public view; reads _balances[account]
BurnMoon constructor; mints 100000000000 * 10**18 to msg.sender
BurnMoon._beforeTokenTransfer override; hook executed by _transfer before balance mutations
msg.sender; attacker-controlled caller used as sender in transfer and as mint beneficiary in the constructor
block.timestamp; miner-influenced value used together with block.difficulty to derive the transfer fee
block.difficulty * block.timestamp unchecked multiplication forming the entropy source of the fee
FeeNumber = ((block.difficulty * block.timestamp) % 100) + 1; timestamp-dependent fee selection that can be ground down to a 1% fee by miners
recipient parameter of transfer(address recipient, uint256 amount)
amount parameter of transfer(address recipient, uint256 amount)
sender parameter of transferFrom(address sender, address recipient, uint256 amount)
recipient parameter of transferFrom(address sender, address recipient, uint256 amount)
amount parameter of transferFrom(address sender, address recipient, uint256 amount)
currentAllowance local in transferFrom, read from _allowances and compared with amount
sender parameter of _transfer(address sender, address recipient, uint256 amount)
recipient parameter of _transfer(address sender, address recipient, uint256 amount)
amount parameter of _transfer(address sender, address recipient, uint256 amount)
senderBalance local in _transfer, snapshot of _balances[sender] before mutation
receiveAmount = amount - feeAmount; amount credited to the recipient
senderAmount = senderBalance - amount; value written back to _balances[sender]
account parameter of _burn(address account, uint256 amount), receives the fee payer
amount parameter of _burn(address account, uint256 amount), equals feeAmount during transfers
accountBalance local in _burn, snapshot of _balances[account] before the burn
owner parameter of _approve(address owner, address spender, uint256 amount)
spender parameter of _approve(address owner, address spender, uint256 amount)
amount parameter of _approve(address owner, address spender, uint256 amount)
account parameter of balanceOf(address account)

edges.reason: msg.sender is forwarded through _msgSender() as the sender argument of _transfer inside transfer
caller-controlled msg.sender reaches _transfer and seeds the balance-debit path
block.timestamp is an operand of the fee entropy multiplication, making the fee miner-influenceable
product of block.difficulty and block.timestamp is taken modulo 100 and offset by 1 to select the fee
timestamp/difficulty derived value is written into the FeeNumber state variable on every transfer
the timestamp-dependent fee computation executes unconditionally inside _transfer before balance updates
FeeNumber is read to compute feeAmount = amount * FeeNumber / 100
feeAmount is consumed by the receiveAmount/senderAmount arithmetic in _transfer
feeAmount is passed as the burn amount so the fee is destroyed rather than transferred
transfer delegates execution to the internal _transfer routine
transferFrom delegates execution to the internal _transfer routine
transferFrom calls _approve to write the reduced allowance back into _allowances
approve routes through the internal _approve helper
increaseAllowance routes through the internal _approve helper
decreaseAllowance routes through the internal _approve helper
_transfer invokes the internal _burn routine to destroy the collected fee
_transfer writes _balances[sender] and adds to _balances[recipient]
_burn debits _balances[account] by the burned amount
_burn decreases the _totalSupply state variable
_mint credits _balances[account] with the minted amount
_mint increases the _totalSupply state variable
the BurnMoon constructor calls _mint to create the initial supply
the constructor mints the entire 100000000000e18 supply to msg.sender
BurnMoon._beforeTokenTransfer hook is invoked by _transfer before balances are rewritten
_balances[sender] is read into the senderBalance local for the balance check and debit
_allowances[sender][msg.sender] is read in transferFrom for the allowance check
_approve writes the _allowances allowance table
the hardcoded DevWallet address is compared against sender/recipient to waive the fee to 1 wei
recipient parameter of transfer is passed on to _transfer
amount parameter of transfer is passed on to _transfer
sender parameter of transferFrom is passed on to _transfer
recipient parameter of transferFrom is passed on to _transfer
amount parameter of transferFrom is passed on to _transfer
currentAllowance gates the transferFrom execution and is reduced by amount
sender parameter is used for the zero-address check, fee lookups and balance debit in _transfer
recipient parameter receives the net receiveAmount in _transfer
amount parameter drives the fee, receiveAmount and senderAmount computations in _transfer
senderBalance is compared against amount and used to derive senderAmount
receiveAmount is credited to _balances[recipient]
senderAmount is written back into _balances[sender]
account parameter is checked for the zero address and debited inside _burn
amount parameter is subtracted from accountBalance and from _totalSupply in _burn
_balances[account] is read into accountBalance before the burn
accountBalance is verified to be at least amount and then reduced in _burn
owner parameter is checked for the zero address and written into the allowance table
spender parameter is checked for the zero address and written into the allowance table
amount parameter is stored as the allowance in _approve
account parameter indexes _balances for the balanceOf return value

normalization_plan.reason: recipient is a parameter local to transfer and has no independent identity beyond the function's argument list
amount is a parameter local to transfer and should be collapsed into the function node
sender is a parameter only meaningful inside transferFrom and is merged into that function
recipient is a parameter only meaningful inside transferFrom and is merged into that function
amount is a parameter only meaningful inside transferFrom and is merged into that function
currentAllowance is a short-lived local inside transferFrom used solely for the allowance check
sender is the primary argument of _transfer and belongs to that function node
recipient is the primary destination argument of _transfer and belongs to that function node
amount is the primary value argument of _transfer and belongs to that function node
senderBalance is an intra-function snapshot local that does not need a standalone node
receiveAmount is an intra-function computation local derived from amount and feeAmount
senderAmount is an intra-function computation local written back to _balances[sender]
account is a parameter of _burn and belongs to the burn function node
amount is a parameter of _burn and belongs to the burn function node
accountBalance is a local snapshot inside _burn used only for the balance check
owner is a parameter of _approve and belongs to the approval function node
spender is a parameter of _approve and belongs to the approval function node
amount is a parameter of _approve and belongs to the approval function node
